title: ✡️ We put Israel's interests before ours. Trump did that.
text:
✡️ We put Israel's interests before ours. Trump did that."

"Tucker Carlson on Trump:"

"This war is clearly contrary to what he promised and contrary to the idea that your leaders should put your interests before those of foreigners. "

"We put Israel's interests before ours. Trump did that."

"Source: The Economist
